hooks.name: Installed Power Capability Index
hooks.description: Indexes installed powers and limits activation to the smallest task-relevant capability.

action.prompt: Installed powers: design-system-power-builder (design systems); nova-act and kane-cli (browser QA); postman (API resources); context7 (current docs); exa (web research); datadog (observability); ltm-power (project memory); cubic-code-review (code review); cloudinary (media); supabase-hosted (Supabase). For architecture impact and blast-radius analysis use scripts/graph-impact.mjs (the graph-impact skill), not an external power. Activate only the smallest relevant power, or none when no capability matches. Do not use external services without task-specific need. Use Postman MCP only for Postman operations and preserve repository rules.
